intro: A short, kid-friendly look at what is happening today.

slides.title: Rain watch continues
slides.summary: The IMD has warned of heavy rain, thunderstorms and gusty winds in several parts of Kerala from 7 to 10 October.
slides.fun: A yellow alert means people should stay weather-aware.

slides.title: Revive supports students
slides.summary: Kerala has launched the Revive programme to give extra support to students who find studies difficult.
slides.fun: Extra practice and resources can help learners build confidence.
slides.source: Kerala PSC Current Affairs Brief, 7 Oct 2026

slides.title: WOMN adds hygiene facilities
slides.summary: Sanitary-napkin vending machines and incinerators have been installed at 14 KSRTC depots and terminals.
slides.fun: Small public facilities can make travel easier for many people.
slides.source: Kerala PSC Current Affairs Brief, 7 Oct 2026

slides.title: India's 2036 Olympic bid
slides.summary: India's bid to host the 2036 Olympic Games is part of a wider effort to become a stronger sporting nation.
slides.fun: Hosting the Olympics needs planning for venues, transport and accommodation.

slides.title: Harmanpreet Kaur steps down
slides.summary: India women's cricket captain Harmanpreet Kaur has stepped down as captain across formats.
slides.fun: A captain helps lead a team and makes important decisions during matches.

people.name: Harmanpreet Kaur
people.why: She stepped down as captain across formats.

slides.title: Saffron cultivation in Leh
slides.summary: A current-affairs roundup reports an announcement about saffron cultivation in Leh.
slides.fun: Saffron comes from the red-orange stigmas of a flower.

slides.title: Chemistry Nobel honours mirror-image chemistry
slides.summary: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for discoveries about asymmetric organic synthesis.
slides.fun: Some molecules have left- and right-handed forms that can behave differently.

people.name: Henri B. Kagan
people.why: He shared the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

slides.title: Crew-12 starts its trip home
slides.summary: Four astronauts undocked from the International Space Station on 7 October and began returning to Earth aboard a SpaceX Dragon.
slides.fun: The crew had spent about eight months in orbit.

people.name: Jessica Meir
people.why: She is one of the Crew-12 astronauts returning to Earth.

slides.title: Francis Halzen wins Physics Nobel
slides.summary: Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for work on the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and high-energy neutrinos.
slides.fun: Neutrinos are tiny particles that can travel huge distances through space.

people.name: Francis Halzen
people.why: His neutrino research earned the 2026 Physics Nobel.

quiz.q: What weather is Kerala expecting in several districts?
quiz.why: The IMD warning mentions heavy rain, thunderstorms and gusty winds.

quiz.q: What is the Revive programme designed to do?
quiz.why: It gives extra support to students who face difficulties in studies.

quiz.q: At how many KSRTC depots and terminals were WOMN facilities reported?
quiz.why: The report says 14 depots and terminals.

quiz.q: Which event is India bidding to host in 2036?
quiz.why: India is pursuing a bid for the 2036 Olympics.

quiz.q: Who stepped down as India's women's cricket captain across formats?
quiz.why: Reports on 7 October named Harmanpreet Kaur.

options: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai
quiz.why: Kagan and Soai shared the Chemistry Nobel.

options: Launched a telescope from the Moon
quiz.why: The four astronauts undocked from the International Space Station.
